issues.description: Captures any issues that occurred while deserializing from filesystem

onlyRootPackageTests.description: When true, tests will only be generated for the root package.

hardwareProfileInstanceType.description:
If specified, bundler job will be executed on a worker node with below hardware, e.g. r5.4xlarge.
Note: {@link UiBundler} needs a hardware/instance with minimum of 6GB of RAM.
See {@link HardwareProfile} for more info.

maxConcurrencyPerNode.description:
The maximum number of invalidation queue entries that will be processed simultaneously for {@link UiBundler} job per node.
1 means {@link UiBundler} runs webpack compilers sequentially. Set to higher number based on available workers' memory.

maxConcurrency.description:
The maximum number of invalidation queue entries that will be processed simultaneously for {@link UiBundler} job.
1 means {@link UiBundler} runs webpack compilers sequentially. This number has to be equal or greater than
{@link maxConcurrencyPerNode} as it takes precedence in the total number of concurrent batches. When its value is -1, there
will be no limit and only {@link maxConcurrencyPerNode} and the number of nodes in the cluster will determine how many batches
are processed at the same time.

outputDirTtl.description:
"Time to live" for the output dir.
This will determine for how much time the directory will exist before
the platform can delete it.

Note that the output directory will be deleted by the bundler after it is used
but this ensures that if the directory remains in the file system, the platform
can remove it automatically.

Current value is 2 hours.

keepUiBundlerResults.description: Determines if the {@link UiBundlerResult} records created by each job will be cleared or not once the job is finished.

developmentBatchSize.description:
The batch sizes for UiBundler jobs in development mode. Each batch will bundle a set of
webpack configurations.

The batch size will default to 3 webpack configurations to bundle per batch job.

productionBatchSize.description:
The batch sizes for UiBundler jobs in production mode. It is recommended to keep as default because production mode
requires a lot of resources in some packages.

enableWebpackCache.description: Determines if the Webpack cache should be enabled.

enableBabelCache.description: Determines if the Babel cache should be enabled.

title: The UiBundlerConfig type defines configuration settings for {@link UiBundler}.
